source: public: EA188 1.9 TDI with the Bosch VP37 rotary injection pump (non-PD; engines 1Z/AHU/AFN/AVG/AHH/AJM) runs Bosch EDC15V — a widely-documented VAG engine->ECU-generation mapping.
notes: 1.9 TDI VP37 (pre-Pumpe-Duese). part_numbers key '028906021' is the VAG part-number prefix AAA(028)+906(engine-electronics group)+subgroup; it scopes to the 028-platform engine ECU but is NOT a single-SW-unique key and will also match sibling 028906021xx variants. K-line (ISO 9141 / KWP2000), so no 0x7E0 address. 'confidence'/'notes' are informational and ignored by the loader.

source: public: EA188 1.9 TDI PD (Pumpe-Duese; engines ATD/AXR/ASZ/AJM/AUY/BEW) used Bosch EDC15P in the first PD generation before moving to EDC16 — a widely-documented mapping across VAG service and tuning references.
notes: 1.9 TDI PD, first (EDC15P) generation. part_numbers key '038906019' = 038-platform engine-electronics prefix (engine-family scope, not SW-unique). K-line era, no 0x7E0. Later PD cars (2003+) move to EDC16 under the 03G prefix — see the EDC16U34 entry.

source: public: EA188 1.9 TDI PD (BXE/BKC/BLS/BXF) and EA188 2.0 TDI PD (BKD/BMM/BMN/AZV/BKP) run Bosch EDC16U31/U34 (MPC56x). This is the generation OpenTune has a real map library and checksum support for (EDC16U34).
notes: 1.9 & 2.0 TDI PD, EDC16 generation. part_numbers key '03G906' = 03G-platform engine-electronics prefix (engine-family scope; matches 03G906016/018/021 and letter-suffixed SW variants, NOT SW-unique). 0x7E0 = CAN UDS/OBD (EDC16 moved to CAN). Exact U31-vs-U34 sub-variant splits by displacement/power and is not pinned per model/year; ecudef_id points at the EDC16U34 definition OpenTune ships.

source: public: EA189 1.6 TDI common-rail (engines CAYA/CAYB/CAYC/CAYE/CLNA) runs the Siemens/Continental Simos PCR2.1 ECU — the family OpenTune has a checksum solution and ecudef for. Widely documented across VAG CR TDI references.
notes: 1.6 TDI CR (EA189). part_numbers key '03L906' = EA189 common-rail engine-electronics prefix. NOTE: 03L906 is shared with the EA189 *2.0* TDI CR (Bosch EDC17) entry below — a bare 03L906 part number alone does NOT distinguish 1.6-PCR2.1 from 2.0-EDC17; disambiguate by displacement/engine-code. 0x7E0 CAN UDS. This is the 1.6 'dieselgate' engine (CAYC).

source: public: EA189 2.0 TDI common-rail (engines CBAB/CBBB/CFFB/CFGB/CBDB/CJAA/CLCA/CFHC) runs Bosch EDC17 (EDC17C46/CP20/C54 across markets/years) — widely documented; this is the 2.0 'dieselgate' engine family.
notes: 2.0 TDI CR (EA189). EDC17 family is confident; the exact EDC17 sub-variant (C46 vs CP20 vs C54) tracks market/MY and is NOT resolved here (treat family as a candidate set). part_numbers key '03L906' is SHARED with the 1.6-PCR2.1 entry above (same EA189 03L platform) — disambiguate by displacement. 0x7E0 CAN UDS.

source: public: EA288 1.6/2.0 TDI common-rail (engines CRBC/CRLB/DBGC/DFGA/CLHA) runs Bosch EDC17C64/C74, with the later evo cars on Bosch MD1CS001. Widely documented MQB-era mapping.
notes: 2.0/1.6 TDI CR (EA288). NOTE: the 04L906 scanned part numbers already appear in catalog/opendbc-volkswagen.json but with family=null — this entry adds the ECU-family mapping (and the 05L906 EA288-evo prefix). EDC17 vs MD1 splits early-vs-late and is not pinned. part_numbers keys are engine-electronics-group prefixes (engine-family scope). 0x7E0 CAN UDS.
